race.comment: ROSES IMMINENTE (2) was more than adequate when running in a Highway at Randwick not that long back. The run before in a BM66 was good too. She really does look like this distance will suit and gets the right jockey. GRAFOLOGY (8) did a good job to win at Tamworth before coming from a long way off them two weeks ago. Does finally step up in journey which has to help. AUTUMN HEIR (3) did little when resuming but goes OK second up. Probably wants it to be wet. WIZARD'S STAR (5) is a four-time placegetter in 15 career starts, but still looking for a maiden success. Last appeared when sixth over 1800m at Hawkesbury on October 27. Wider plays.
